newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank active on lower Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank active on lower Estonian bourse.

text.p: Estonian market leader Hansapank was in the stock exchange spotlight on Wednesday, taking the lion's share of trade as the market awaits its 1996 profits and forecast for 1997, dealers said.
The market as a whole slipped again after last week's prolonged rallies.
Overall official list turnover was 82.3 million kroons but the stock exchange dipped 1.65 percent to 193.96.
Hansapank, to announce its profits and forecast on Thursday, had volume of 52.5 million kroons.
However, it closed 1.25 kroons down at 183.80.
"On the eve of the Hansapank profit announcement dealers were a bit confused about the price," said one trader.
Shares in Forekspank turned over 8.4 million kroons and closed lower at 140 kroons versus 142.78.
Union Bank had volume of 6.9 million kroons and dropped 0.85 kroons to 44.20.
Estonia's second bank, Savings Bank, had trade of 6 million kroons and closed at 87.80 kroons versus 88.50.
The over-the-counter market turned over 14.1 million kroons and the Norma plastics maker was the most active share.
It saw activity of 4.7 million kroons and ended to close slightly lower at 54 kroons.
